AAL.caption: Phone Changed
AAL.doc: Triggered every time the user modifies the phone input value.
AAL.name: phone_changed

AAM.caption: Phone Valid
AAM.doc: Triggered when the phone number becomes valid according to the selected country’s pattern.
AAM.name: phone_valid

AAN.caption: Phone Invalid
AAN.doc: Triggered when the phone number becomes invalid (length or pattern mismatch).
AAN.name: phone_invalid

AAO.caption: Country Changed
AAO.doc: Triggered after the user selects a different country from the dropdown modal.
AAO.name: country_changed

AAj.caption: Country Modal Opened
AAj.doc: Triggered the moment the country selection modal becomes visible.
AAj.name: country_modal_opened

AAk.caption: Input Focused
AAk.doc: Triggered when the country modal is closed.
AAk.name: input_focused

AAl.caption: Input Blurred
AAl.doc: Triggered when the phone input field receives focus.
AAl.name: input_blurred

AAm.caption: Country Modal Closed
AAm.doc: Triggered when the phone input loses focus.
AAm.name: country_modal_closed

AAP.caption: Default Value
AAP.doc: This field lets you pre-fill the input with a phone number when the element is loaded.
AAP.name: default_value

AAe.caption: Show Flag
AAe.doc: Shows or hides the country flag in the input and in the country list dropdown.
AAe.name: show_flag

AAf.caption: Show dial code
AAf.doc: Shows or hides the dial code (+373, +40, etc.) next to the flag.
AAf.name: show_dial_code

AAg.caption: Enable formatting
AAg.doc: When enabled, the phone number is automatically formatted based on the selected country pattern. When disabled → typing works as raw digits only (no spaces, no separators).
AAg.name: enable_formatting

ABM.caption: ISO Country Name
ABM.doc: The ISO country code (e.g., AF, AE, AL).
ABM.name: default_dialCode

ABO.caption: Placeholder
ABO.doc: Placeholder text displayed when the input is empty.
ABO.name: inputPlaceholder

ABP.caption: Placeholder Color
ABP.doc: Defines the color used for all visible text in the phone input, including typed numbers and country details.
ABP.name: placeholder_color

ABQ.caption: Text Color
ABQ.doc: Specifies the color of the placeholder text shown in the input before the user types anything.
ABQ.name: textColor

AAE.caption: Full Number
AAE.doc: The complete formatted number, including the country prefix.
AAE.name: full_number

AAF.caption: Country Name
AAF.doc: The name of the selected country.
AAF.name: country_name

AAG.caption: ISO Country Name
AAG.doc: The ISO country code (e.g., AF, AE, AL).
AAG.name: ISO_country_name

AAJ.caption: is valid
AAJ.doc: Indicates whether the number is valid according to the country pattern.
AAJ.name: is_valid

AAc.caption: error_message
AAc.doc: The error message (optional, empty if none).
AAc.name: error_message

ABS.caption: e164 Number
ABS.doc: The phone number in E.164 international format. No spaces or separators — digits only after the country code. Standard format used by Twilio, WhatsApp, SMS APIs, and most telephony services.
ABS.name: e164_number
